name: lumen
description: Precise local semantic code search via MCP. Indexes your codebase with Go AST parsing, embeds with Ollama, LM Studio, or HuggingFace TEI, and exposes vector search to Claude through an MCP server — no cloud, no npm.

backend.title: Embedding backend
backend.description: Embedding backend to use: ollama, lmstudio, or tei

host.title: Server host URL
host.description: URL of your embedding server (e.g. http://localhost:52000 for TEI, http://localhost:11434 for Ollama)

model.title: Embedding model
model.description: Model name for embeddings (must match what your server has loaded)
